expected_items.description: Interpret the user's money/profit-side expert request as a reusable platform agent for profit, ROI, cost-benefit, pricing, and unit-economics judgment.
expected_items.rationale: The request was summarized and the plan records the Profit Analyst agent interpretation.

expected_items.description: Run web-first research and save a public search record.
expected_items.rationale: The search record lists queries, sources checked, weak sources ignored, plan impact, and uncertainty.

expected_items.description: Add or link the durable requirement for the Profit Analyst agent.
Create an inspectable agent spec with revenue/cost drivers, ROI, NPV, payback, break-even, unit economics, pricing, opportunity cost, scenario/sensitivity, and source provenance.
expected_items.rationale: The agent spec includes trigger, output contract, analysis modes, required inputs, safety rules, and validation commands.

expected_items.description: Prevent misuse as personal investment, tax, legal, accounting, lending, or regulated-finance final advice.
expected_items.rationale: The policy and docs explicitly require educational framing, professional review, or human checkpoints for high-risk financial decisions.

expected_items.description: Ensure money upside does not bypass safety, law, privacy, user trust, quality, or required verification.
expected_items.rationale: The safety rules state that money upside cannot override legality, safety, privacy, user trust, or verification.

acceptance_checks.description: Confirm the new agent appears in the registry list.
Run platform tests and monitor build checks.
acceptance_checks.rationale: All commands completed with exit code 0.

known_omission_risks: No standalone financial model, spreadsheet workbook, calculator UI, or investment recommendation runtime was implemented because the current request was satisfied by a reusable platform agent spec and docs.
notes: The agent complements timekeeper-agent and positive-vision-agent rather than replacing them.
